name: Shield
description: Shield entity extending base item schema with AC bonus and strength/stealth properties.

ac_bonus.description: Armor Class bonus granted by wielding this shield (standard 5e shield is +2).

strength_requirement.description: Minimum Strength score required to use without penalty.

stealth_disadvantage.description: Whether wielding this shield imposes disadvantage on Dexterity (Stealth) checks.
